convert_dpt_checkpoint: convert a DPT SwinV2 checkpoint from MiDaS to HuggingFace format and save to a local directory
get_dpt_config: get DPT configuration and image size for a SwinV2-based depth estimation model variant
create_rename_keys: create a list of state dict key mappings to rename MiDaS checkpoint keys to HuggingFace DPT keys
read_in_q_k_v: split combined QKV projection matrices into separate query, key, and value weight tensors
test_convert_dpt_checkpoint: test the DPT checkpoint conversion by verifying output shape and logits against expected values
